svg.title: J12 Checking a number on WhatsApp when it is added, and other ways to send (v1.2.2, v1.2.3)

g.text: J12 Checking a number on WhatsApp when it is added, and other ways to send (v1.2.2, v1.2.3)
through the window.Hisaab hooks of app.js.
No app can ask WhatsApp beforehand whether a number
has an account, so the owner answers.
Check the number when the customer is added
a loaded shop file offers nothing
[WhatsApp said the number is not on WhatsApp]
any customer page has Check on WhatsApp
The reminder to a refused number
the app never sends by itself
